1. **RevenueCat State of Subscription Apps 2026 — Health & Fitness retention metrics** [third-party]  
   - Health & Fitness had **median RPI of $0.48 at D14**, **$0.66 by D60**, and **yearly RLTV of $35.64**. The report also states that **yearly plans achieve significantly higher Y1 retention: median 20–40%** versus **monthly 6–14%** and **weekly 1–2%**; it also says **annual median fell from 31% to 28%** and **monthly from 10% to 8%** versus the previous period. [1]  
   - Quote: “**Health & Fitness apps lead yearly RLTV at $35.64 median**” and “**Yearly plans achieve significantly higher Y1 retention: median 20-40% (yearly) vs. 1-2% (weekly) and 6-14% (monthly).**” [1]  
   - Site / title: RevenueCat — *State of Subscription Apps 2026* [1]  
   - Date: last updated 2026-08-26 [1]  
   - URL: https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/ [1]

2. **RevenueCat State of Subscription Apps 2025 — Health & Fitness retention metrics** [third-party]  
   - The retrieved snippet does **not** expose Health & Fitness-specific month-1 renewal rate, month-12 retention, trial conversion, or realized LTV figures. It does say **weekly plan retention is uniformly low** and that **first renewal has the biggest impact, with 30–50% churn on weekly plans and 15–40% on monthly**. [4]  
   - Quote: “**Weekly plan retention is uniformly low**” and “**The first renewal has the biggest impact**.” [4]  
   - Site / title: RevenueCat — *State of Subscription Apps 2025* [4]
